import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

from customers import Customer, group_by_city, group_by_plan, top_spenders

people = [
    Customer("Mina", "Oslo", "pro", 40.0),
    Customer("Abe", "Lima", "free", 0.0),
    Customer("Zoe", "Oslo", "free", 0.0),
    Customer("Kai", "Lima", "pro", 55.5),
    Customer("Bea", "Oslo", "team", 120.0),
]
for grouping in (group_by_city, group_by_plan):
    for key, members in grouping(people).items():
        print(grouping.__name__, key, [m.name for m in members])
print(group_by_city([]), group_by_plan([]))
print(top_spenders(people))
assert list(group_by_city(people)) == ["Lima", "Oslo"]
assert list(group_by_plan(people)) == ["free", "pro", "team"]
print("ok")
